text:
Jessica C: Heads-up — running a 30m micro-workshop "Dedicated migration preflight" for 8 customers next Tue. Need host + backup, prework link, and timezone-friendly timing. Who can lead?
Devon: I can host, prefer 11am PT / 2pm ET. What timezone mix we have?
Mike: happy to be backup. count me in for Q&A. I'll grab the calendar invite.
Jessica C: Great — @devon host, @mike backup. Also need someone to capture feedback + follow-up tasks (1 pager). Lina?
Lina: I can do notes & follow-ups. Will prepare a short feedback rubric.
Jessica C: Awesome. Customers get 30m hands-on + 10m follow-up email. Capacity 8 seats. Prework is 3 checklist items — please ask customers to complete: 1) account linkage, 2) sample prompt set, 3) perf baseline export. Link: https://redwood.example.com/prework-micro
Samir: Quick timezone note — we have 3 APAC seats, prefer early morning PT or evening CET. Could we offer two slots same day?
Devon: We can do two 30m slots: 11am PT (18:00 UTC) and 4pm PT (23:00 UTC) — would that cover APAC? maybe tough for APAC evening.
Mike: let's poll customers for preferred slot. I'll draft short DM.
Jessica C: draft DM ok. Use this blurb:
```
Hi — quick invite: 30m micro-workshop on Dedicated migration. Please pick 11am PT or 4pm PT and complete prework: [link]. Seats limited to 8, first come.
```
Mike: posted to invited list. Also set calendar to require RSVP and disable auto-join.
cs-bot: Calendar event created: 'Micro-workshop: Dedicated migration' — 11:00 PT & 16:00 PT — invites sent (8). Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/abc123
Lina: I'll make the feedback rubric template and add a short post-session survey (3 q) to the follow-up email.
Jessica C: Perfect. Actions: Devon (host), Mike (backup + invites), Lina (notes + survey), Jessica (exec summary + follow-ups). I'll update the enablement tracker. :rocket:
Devon: confirmed. see you all — will prep demo image + small seed dataset.
Mike: ping me if you need a mock customer account, I can spin one up.
Jessica C: thanks everyone — will post final agenda tomorrow and cc customers.
